profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with a Master of Science in Computer Science. Skilled in the development of applications using ASP.NET, MVC, REST API, Entity Framework, SQL Server, JSON and XML Web Services, CSS, and JavaScript libraries such as jQuery and ReactJS. Strong background in computer science and a commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions.

Personal site: https://uyen.dev/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: TypeScript · CSS · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Angular · Microsoft Azure · T-SQL Stored Procedures · C# · ASP.NET Web API · REST APIs · Databases · jQuery · CROSS · MSSQL · ASP.NET MVC · SharePoint · AngularJS · ASP.NET Core · LINQ to SQL · Bootstrap · Scss · Agile SCRUM · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed back-end  and front-end solutions for the web application of Decision Ready Solutions utilizing technologies such as ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework, Bootstrap, JQuery, and JavaScript

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design, develop, test, and release new features for Fannie Mae, PennyMac, and FifthThird's fintech applications. Implemented components to retrieve and validate loan information using REST API.

Monitored and supported the production application, ensuring seamless functionality and performance

Proficient in technologies such as ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework, LINQ, Json or XML Web Services, Bootstrap, Jquery, JavaScript, Rest API, SQL Server, TFS
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · JavaScript · XML · T-SQL Stored Procedures · C# · Front-End Development · REST APIs · Databases · Entity Framework · JSON · jQuery · ASP.NET MVC · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · Web Services API · Microsoft SQL Server · LINQ to SQL · Bootstrap

positions.title: Programming Instructor
positions.description:
Taught courses in JavaScript, C, C++, SQL, and Data Structures
Conducted lab assignments to provide hands-on experience with the programming languages and data structures
Assessed student performance through quizzes, exams, and projects, providing constructive feedback to support their growth
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · C++ · C# · Databases · Data Modeling

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created Ligaris Intranet, an internal blog platform for companies to use for communication and collaboration. Built using WordPress, JavaScript, CSS, and MySQL, the platform streamlined internal communication for businesses.
Developed and launched Harlem Wine, a wine discovery tool that leverages a user's current location to suggest nearby wine options and where they can be purchased. Utilized JavaScript, PHP, jQuery, CSS, and MySQL in building the platform
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · C# · Databases · Web Applications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed the Laboratoires Klorane tool, a platform that assists users in finding the right Klorane hair care products, including conditioners and moisturizers. The platform supports multiple languages and was built using Symfony, jQuery, CSS, and MySQL
Designed and implemented Project Management System, a comprehensive project management system and timesheet application for employees. The system enables employees to easily input their daily hours and tasks, streamlining the reporting process. Utilized Zend, jQuery, CSS, and MySQL in the development of the platform
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · C# · Databases · Web Applications
